purpose: Implement issue 349: structured per-AC probes resolved by the deterministic verify engine.
responsibilities: @stravica-ai/rcf-schemas minor: optional probe object on $defs/acceptanceCriterion { method, path, expectStatus, expectHeader { name, match }, expectBody { contains | matches }, selector }.
src/verify/engine/catalog.js (new): reads rcf/verify-catalog.json { probes: { <acId>: probe } }; an AC-level probe wins over the catalog entry.
src/verify/engine/deterministic.js: resolves each in-scope AC with a probe to pass, fail or skipped with evidence; no probe keeps critique-only; --parity-env selects the target environment.
src/cli/define.js: rcf define create ac and rcf define update gain --probe <json> and --probe-file <path>.
internalStructure: The resolver is a pure function of (probe, fetch response, optional DOM snapshot); the fetch seam stays deps.fetchImpl; the selector probe uses the declared optional Playwright peer in-process, never the MCP browser.

interfaces.name: rcf verify run --mode deterministic
interfaces.description:
usage: rcf verify run --url <url> [--fbs <id>] --mode deterministic [--parity-env <env>]
Per AC: pass, fail or skipped with evidence when a probe exists, critiqueOnly otherwise. runStats.counts { verified, failed, skipped, critiqueOnly, total }. Exit 0 when every in-scope AC passed, 4 otherwise.

interfaces.name: rcf/verify-catalog.json
interfaces.description: format: JSON { catalogVersion: 1, probes: { <acId>: Probe } }; written through rcf define update <us-id> --ac <ac-id> --probe or edited by the test-author hand.

interfaces.name: Probe
interfaces.description: fields: method (GET default), path, expectStatus, expectHeader { name, match }, expectBody { contains | matches }, selector, parityEnv

notes: Build-ordering constraint: the rcf-schemas minor (optional probe on acceptanceCriterion) must publish and be pinned before FBS-218 can merge; the catalog file alone needs no schema change.
name: Per-AC probe catalog resolved by deterministic verify (issue 349)
